paper.title: Fully Explicit Dynamic Gaussian Splatting
paper.relevance_to_adags: Per-primitive onset/offset opacity is the K=1 case of multi-interval presence, and its static Gaussians carry NO temporal opacity at all. It is therefore the sharpest available foil for the return claim: a single interval cannot resume after an absence.

licence.reading: CC BY-NC 4.0 — non-commercial only, and a content licence applied to code. GitHub reports NOASSERTION because CC BY-NC is not in its code-licence list. Not copyleft over derived code the way GPL-3.0 is (contrast multi4d-pin.json), but the NonCommercial term is a distribution constraint that must be settled before release. Recorded so the decision is explicit rather than implicit.

audited_run_facts._source: static read of the pinned checkout, 2026-09-19; load-bearing items independently re-verified before being acted on
audited_run_facts.config_flag: --configpath (README says --config, which only works via argparse prefix matching)
audited_run_facts.schedule: 40,000 iterations, single stage; configs/N3V/n3v_base.json is the ONLY N3V config and all six scenes share it
audited_run_facts.position_lr_horizon: position_lr_max_steps and dynamic_position_lr_max_steps are both 30000, so both LR schedules saturate 10k iterations before the run ends
audited_run_facts.held_out_camera: hardcoded: train = cameras whose path lacks cam00, test = those containing it. eval and llffhold are ignored on this path. 19 train / 1 test.
audited_run_facts.poses_bounds_is_inert_at_train_time: parsed then discarded; load-bearing only in preprocessing, where row i must correspond to the i-th sorted cam*.mp4
audited_run_facts.resolution: frames must be extracted at NATIVE 2704x2028; resolution=2 halves them to 1352x1014 at load (scene/cameras.py loadCamVideo). Pre-halving would desync the COLMAP intrinsics.
audited_run_facts.progressive_window: training starts on start_duration=10 frames and grows +time_interval=10 every progressive_growing_steps=400 iterations, reaching the full 300 frames near iteration 12000
audited_run_facts.in_training_evaluation: NONE. test_iterations defaults to [7000000] and the two lines that would append args.iterations are commented out, so a default run never prints a held-out PSNR. Evaluation is render.py only.
audited_run_facts.metrics: render.py computes PSNR (unclamped), Gaussian-window SSIM, two skimage SSIMs, and LPIPS alex + vgg via the VENDORED lpipsPyTorch (not the lpips pip package). lpipsPyTorch applies a fixed z-score to [0,1] inputs, equivalent to normalize=True in the reference package -- so unlike Multi4D, this LPIPS is standard.
audited_run_facts.skimage_pin_reason: render.py passes multichannel= to skimage structural_similarity. 0.22.x absorbs it into **kwargs and ignores it; 0.23 removed it. Pinned 0.22.0.

opacity_reset_interval_IS_DEAD_CODE.finding: declared at arguments/__init__.py:115 and set in every config JSON, but read by NO python code; reset_opacity is defined in scene/gaussian_model.py:210 and scene/c_gaussian_model.py:549 and never called anywhere
opacity_reset_interval_IS_DEAD_CODE.verified_by: repo-wide grep for both symbols, contrasted against densification_interval which has seven train.py call sites
opacity_reset_interval_IS_DEAD_CODE.consequence: the planned A/B of shipped 50000 vs released 10000 is VACUOUS -- both values produce bit-identical training. The arm was dropped and replaced with 3 repetitions of the single real configuration. It also explains the 50000-vs-10000 discrepancy between the shipped config and the released cfg_args as cosmetic drift in a field nothing reads.

preprocessing_extracts_nothing_as_shippe.finding: scripts/pre_n3d_colmap.py extractframes guards with all(os.path.join(...) for i in range(...)). os.path.join returns a non-empty string, always truthy, so all(...) is unconditionally True and the function returns having written nothing. The author meant os.path.exists.
preprocessing_extracts_nothing_as_shippe.handling: the substrate is NOT patched. An external script mirroring the upstream body writes the frames, after which the broken guard correctly skips and steps 2-4 build colmap_0 from real data.

audited_run_facts.colmap: steps feature_extractor -> exhaustive_matcher -> point_triangulator -> image_undistorter, frame 0 only, invoked as a bare colmap through os.system, so it must be on PATH. SIFT extraction and matching default to use_gpu=1 with no override, which is upstream issue #8 on headless nodes; our container wrapper sets QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen and was previously verified to produce inliers.
audited_run_facts.writes_into_source_path: scene/dataset_readers.py writes points3D.ply into <source>/colmap_0/sparse/0/ on first open, at RENDER time as well as train time. --source_path must therefore be a writable staging copy, never the read-only N3V tree.
audited_run_facts.render_py_reads_cfg_args: get_combined_args merges the cfg_args of the model over the CLI, and ModelParams is constructed with sentinel=True so all its defaults are None and come from cfg_args unless passed explicitly. The released cfg_args carries the source_path of the authors, so --source_path MUST be passed at render time.
audited_run_facts.render_py_overwrites_metrics: render.py writes mean_metrics.json and all_metrics.json into --model_path, so it must never be pointed at the pristine unzip; E0 renders from a copy and diffs against the original.
audited_run_facts.render_py_timing_loop: after the metrics, render_set runs 20x500 = 10,000 renders of one camera purely to time them. Slow (minutes), not hung; nothing reported depends on it and --save_img does not change it.
audited_run_facts.resume: CONFIRMED UNUSABLE. --start_checkpoint restores the model, but train.py then unconditionally re-runs the progressive-window setup, resetting sampling to start_duration=10 frames while gaussians.duration stays at 300. A resumed run never gets the window back to 300. Each repetition must be one uninterrupted 40k job.
audited_run_facts.memory: images are NOT held in RAM: lazy_loader streams them through 2 joblib workers, so host RAM is roughly 2-4 GiB, dominated by interpreter and torch footprint rather than pixels. Jobs request 64G, not the 120G Multi4D needed.
audited_run_facts.network_gui: train.py unconditionally binds a loopback TCP listener in an unbounded while True with a port-increment fallback. Harmless under Slurm, but it is a spin loop if binding ever fails for a reason other than the port being taken.

leonardo_environment_as_built.venv: $W/envs/ex4dgs (separate from BOTH envs/adags and envs/multi4d: Ex4DGS wants torch 2.1.2 where Multi4D wants 2.5.1)
env_defects_found_and_fixed: numpy<2 was pinned in one step and silently undone by the next: opencv-python 5.0.0.93 and kornia 0.8.3 both pull numpy>=2, and the extension build then failed. A sequence of pins is not a pin -- a constraints file is now applied to EVERY install, with a hard precondition asserting numpy 1.x, scikit-image<0.23 and torch 2.1.2 before any extension is built.
pip install --upgrade setuptools broke the build with No module named pkg_resources; setuptools >= 81 no longer ships it and these legacy setup.py files import it. Pinned <66.

kornia 0.8.3 is incompatible with torch 2.1.2: it calls .any(dim=(-2,-1)) with a tuple dim, which torch 2.1.2 cannot script. Pinned <0.8 (0.7.4). The repo uses kornia for exactly one symbol, create_meshgrid.

E0_eval_stack_gate.target: the mean_metrics.json shipped with the release, for this exact model
E0_eval_stack_gate.rule: PASS = PSNR within +/-0.05 of 33.73290 AND LPIPS(alex) within 0.002 of 0.04044
E0_eval_stack_gate.added_clause: per-frame PSNR max absolute deviation <= 0.20 dB. This clause is ours, not from the plan: the release ships all_metrics.json, and a matching mean with disagreeing frames would be two errors cancelling, not a pass.
E0_eval_stack_gate.consequence_of_failure: do NOT train. A mismatch here is data, resolution or metric convention, and would be misread later as an optimisation difference.

training_reproduction.context: no third party has reproduced this by training; community reports 31.9-33.3
training_reproduction.rule: PASS = E0 passes AND the best variant >= 33.3
training_reproduction.partial: 32.5 to 33.3 = partial, consistent with community, reported with the point-count diagnostic
training_reproduction.design_change: the 2 variants x 2 reps of the plan became 3 reps of ONE configuration, because opacity_reset_interval is dead code (see audited_run_facts)
